import.intro: Upload a CSV or XLSX file with document descriptions. First a check without writing, then the import.
import.draftNotice: Imported documents are created as drafts: the description and files get the “needs review” status and are never published automatically. Re-importing the same file creates no duplicates — rows are matched by archive code.
import.fileHint: Up to {mb} MB and {rows} rows. The first row holds column headers.
import.branchHint: Fund, inventory and file are looked up in this archive.
import.atomicHint: If any row has an error, nothing is written.
import.confirmText: To create: {create}, drafts to update: {update}. Rows with errors will be skipped.
import.confirmTextAtomic: To create: {create}, drafts to update: {update}. Any error cancels the whole import.
import.mappingHint: Archive code and at least one title are required. Fund, inventory and file go together.
import.notApplied: Import not performed: errors found in “all or nothing” mode. Nothing was written.
import.hierarchyPreview: Will be created: funds {fund}, inventories {inventory}, cases {case}.
import.mappingChanged: The mapping has changed. Check the file again to see the result.
import.appliedNotice: Import finished. New documents are saved as drafts and wait for review.
import.truncated: Showing the first {shown} of {total} rows. The full list of errors is in the report.

export.title: Catalog export
export.intro: Only documents available to your role are exported (branch staff: their branch only). Cells that look like formulas are escaped.
export.done: The export file has been saved.

errors.file_too_large: The file exceeds the size limit.
errors.invalid_file: The file could not be read. Save it as CSV (UTF-8) or XLSX.
errors.unsafe_file: The file contains forbidden XML constructs and was rejected.
errors.file_too_complex: The file is too large when unpacked and was rejected.
errors.unsupported_format: The old .xls format is not supported — save as .xlsx or CSV.
errors.too_many_rows: Too many rows in the file.
errors.too_many_columns: Too many columns in the file.
errors.duplicate_header: Column headers repeat in the file.
errors.no_rows: The file has no data rows.
errors.mapping_unknown_column: The mapping refers to a missing column.
errors.mapping_duplicate_field: One field is chosen for several columns.
errors.mapping_missing_title: Choose at least one title column.
errors.mapping_incomplete_hierarchy: Fund, inventory and file must be mapped together.
errors.invalid_date: Date not recognized (YYYY, YYYY-MM-DD or DD.MM.YYYY).
errors.invalid_period: The period is a decade, e.g. 1950s.
errors.invalid_number: A non-negative whole number is expected.
errors.duplicate_in_file: The archive code repeats in the file.
errors.hierarchy_incomplete: Give fund, inventory and file together.
errors.hierarchy_not_found: No file with these numbers in the selected archive.
errors.forbidden_branch: You may not import into this branch.
errors.forbidden_existing: A document with this code belongs to another branch or cannot be edited.
errors.exists_not_editable: The document is no longer a draft — the import does not change it.
errors.conflict: Write conflict (the archive code is taken).
errors.version_conflict: Someone changed this item at the same time. Reload the page.
errors.translation_requires_draft: Machine translation is only for drafts or items returned for changes.
errors.target_verified: This language is already verified. Confirm overwriting.
errors.nothing_to_translate: There is no text in the source language.
errors.text_too_long: The text is too long for machine translation — translate it manually in parts.
errors.not_machine_translation: This language is not marked as machine-translated.
errors.invalid_language: Choose different source and target languages.
errors.forbidden_create_hierarchy: The fund, inventory or case is missing in the archive and you may not create it. Use an existing case or contact an administrator.

translations.title: Translations
translations.intro: Translation status of items per language. An AI draft translation is marked “machine” and is published only after review through the approval workflow.
translations.machineWorking: AI is translating… this may take a few minutes
translations.machineHint: The result will be marked as machine translation and must be reviewed.
translations.machineDone: The draft translation is saved and marked as machine. Please review the text.
translations.overwriteText: This language was already verified by a person. The machine translation will replace it.
translations.verifyDone: The translation is marked as verified.
translations.onlyDraft: Machine translation is available for drafts and items returned for changes.
translations.emptyListHint: Change the item type, the language or the query.
translations.verifyHint: Read the machine translation and fix it in the item card if needed. Then mark the language as verified: the item cannot be published without it.

title: Catalog import and export
lead: Load document descriptions from CSV or XLSX and export the catalogue to a file.
